pages.title: A table for the camp
text: A feast is a great dish cooked for everyone. Set it down on a solid block and it holds **six servings**; each one you eat fills you and grants that voice's [blessing](voice_blessings) for **8 minutes**.

Cook one at the Hearth Pot from the dishes and crops of its voice: an Earth feast from the Pad-keepers' mash and Grit-baked Bread, a Fire feast from jerky and chili, and so on. Each recipe is in JEI under the pot.
A camp that shares a feast before a night in the March walks out blessed together. A comparator reads how many servings are left.
